tandemFrageBeispiel.antwort: I have a brother, but he lives in Poland.

tandemSoGehts: Cut the cards in the middle. Partner A takes the left half, Partner B the right.
A builds question 1 from the tiles and asks it: “Do you want to come to the cinema?”
B hears the question and builds an answer with a linking word: and (add), but (contrast), or (choice), so (result). Watch the verb forms in both parts: she works, I'm.
Then B asks question 2 and A answers. Take turns. At the end, check with the answer sheet.
Finally: swap cards and do it all again, faster.

tandemRedemittel.p2: A contrast: but. A result: so.

tandemRedemittel.p1: Sorry? Can you say that again, please?
